info.title: NYALES WEB-070 implemented visit-agent identity API
info.description: Identity slice only: registration, one-use pairing, signed nonce/heartbeat/status and revoke. Planning job/OSRM/solver/publish unregistered; separate connection-probe queue contract now implements transport diagnostics. 64 KiB machine request cap. Pairing 15 minutes; credential 30 days; actual environment fixed server-side.

AgentCredential.name: Authorization
AgentCredential.description: Agent <credential-id>.<secret>; never accepted as a user bearer.

x-rules: Registry grants require 1–10 active field reps in the same organization. Editing grants requires pairing again and revokes old credentials/codes.
Code/credential plaintext returned only once. Issuance idempotency retains safe metadata; lost code requires explicit reissue. Pair replay never reissues credential.
PoP verification precedes nonce/jti atomic consumption and DB generation/revocation recheck. Idempotent heartbeat retry needs a fresh proof.
Agent status/heartbeat do not prove OSRM/solver installation and cannot generate or publish schedules.
HTTP loopback allowed only under strict existing local demo guard; deployment requires HTTPS.
Pair rate 20/minute by trusted proxy client IP digest (local fallback bucket); authenticated machine proof rate 120/minute. Failed stores do not bypass limits.
